messages.subject: Counsel's advice on merits - in
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Harriet Stanford's advice is in. Headlines: liability/causation 70-75%; quantum likely to land £1.9m-£2.3m on a £2.418m claim; the management-time head (£126k) is the most exposed and the customer-credits head (£512k) will take some erosion. She recommends we pursue but stay open to settlement around £1.7m-£1.9m if offered pre-trial.

I'll circulate the full advice. Worth flagging the £126k head to Grace so they start pulling contemporaneous records now.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
